store.name: George Stephanis
store.tagline: Small open-source tools I built for myself, free for anyone to reuse.

apps.name: Diff Leppard
apps.subtitle: AI code review on your own model server
apps.description: Code review from your self-hosted LLM (vLLM, Ollama, LM Studio, llama.cpp) as a VS Code extension, CLI, gh extension or GitHub Action.
apps.longDescription: Diff Leppard reviews uncommitted or staged changes, or a GitHub pull request, using any server that speaks the OpenAI chat completions API. Your code goes only to your own server. It can post the result as a real PR review with inline comments on the changed lines. The VS Code extension, CLI, gh extension, GitHub Action, pre-commit hook, Neovim plugin, MCP server and Claude Code plugin all share one review engine and settings.
apps.requirements: Node.js 20+ and an OpenAI-compatible model server
features: Works with vLLM, Ollama, LM Studio, llama.cpp, SGLang, LocalAI and other OpenAI-compatible servers
Posts real GitHub PR reviews with inline comments
VS Code extension, CLI, gh extension and GitHub Action
Watch mode drafts reviews for every PR that requests your review
MCP server and Claude Code plugin for agents

apps.name: NAS Player
apps.subtitle: Play media from your NAS on Android TV
apps.description: An Android TV / Google TV app for video, music and photos straight from SMB or WebDAV shares and USB drives.
apps.longDescription: NAS Player browses SMB 2/3 and WebDAV shares (TrueNAS, Synology, QNAP, Samba, Windows) and USB drives, and plays everything in-app. ExoPlayer handles hardware decoding, HDR and surround passthrough, and libVLC takes over automatically for formats ExoPlayer can't open. It generates and caches thumbnails, reads album tags, remembers resume positions, and picks up sidecar subtitles.
apps.requirements: Android TV or Google TV, Android 8.0 or later
features: SMB 2/3 and WebDAV, with mDNS discovery of SMB servers on your network
USB drive support
ExoPlayer with automatic libVLC fallback for unusual formats
Continue watching, resume positions and watched markers
Photo viewer with slideshow, and sidecar subtitles

apps.name: Home Designer
apps.subtitle: Floor plans with real measurements, in your browser
apps.description: Draw rooms, doors and windows to scale, drag furniture around, and save the plan as an SVG. Nothing is uploaded.
apps.longDescription: A floor-plan editor that runs entirely in the browser. Draw rooms, doors and windows with real measurements, drag furniture around, measure anything, and save the result as an SVG that you can open again later or view in any browser or vector editor.
features: Rooms, doors and windows at real measurements
Draggable furniture
Measure any distance
Saves to and reopens from plain SVG
Runs entirely client-side

apps.name: DeltaScribe Studio
apps.subtitle: Subtitle and lyric timing, in your browser
apps.description: Align subtitles and lyrics to audio or video in the browser. Your media and subtitle files stay on your machine.
apps.longDescription: DeltaScribe is a client-side subtitle and lyric timing studio. Load a video or audio file with SRT, WebVTT or TTML subtitles, retime cues while it plays, and export. Your files aren't uploaded anywhere unless you opt into a feature that sends data out: Chrome's speech recognition, an OpenAI-compatible AI endpoint you configure, or a submit webhook passed in the URL.
features: SRT, WebVTT and TTML import and export
Create new subtitles from scratch
Media and subtitle files stay in the browser
Pre-fill media and subtitles from URL parameters
Optional webhook to submit finished timing

apps.name: Circuit Board Tracer
apps.subtitle: Digitize a two-sided PCB from photos
apps.description: Upload front and back photos of a circuit board, trace copper by clicking, mark vias and holes, and export an SVG and netlist.
apps.longDescription: A browser-only tool for manually digitizing a two-sided circuit board. Upload front and back photos, trace copper paths on each side by clicking points, mark the vias and holes that pass through the board, and export everything as one self-contained SVG that other software can parse. Images never leave the browser.
features: Trace front and back copper from photos
Vias, holes, pads, test points, SMD packages and ground planes
Click any trace to see its whole net
Export a self-contained SVG and a netlist
Autosaves in the browser

apps.name: D&D 5e Character Forge
apps.subtitle: Create, level up and print 5e characters
apps.description: A guided D&D 5th Edition character creator and level-up sheet using SRD 5.1 and 5.2.1 content. Runs in the browser.
apps.longDescription: A responsive, client-side app for creating, managing, leveling up and printing Dungeons & Dragons 5th Edition characters, using the official System Reference Document content (SRD 5.1 and SRD 5.2.1) under CC BY 4.0. Keep a roster of characters, track hit points, spells and features, and print a tabletop sheet.
features: Guided creator for SRD 5.1 and SRD 5.2.1 rules
Level-up flow
Character roster
Spellbook, features and hit point tracking
Printable tabletop sheet

apps.name: gitslim
apps.subtitle: Shrink old git repos to reclaim disk space
apps.description: An interactive TUI that finds git repositories and converts the ones you pick into shallow clones, like npkill for .git folders.
apps.longDescription: gitslim scans a directory tree for git repositories and lists each one's .git size, when it was last committed to, and when its working tree last changed. Mark the repos you want to slim and press S to convert them to shallow clones in place. Repos with unpushed commits are protected. It's a single bash script that runs on the bash 3.2 that ships with macOS.
apps.requirements: bash 3.0+ and git; ~/.local/bin on your PATH
features: Finds every git repo under a folder
Shows .git size and last commit and change times
Converts selected repos to shallow clones in place
Blocks repos with unpushed commits
Single dependency-free bash script

apps.name: WordUp
apps.subtitle: Upload to your WordPress site from the menu bar
apps.description: A macOS menu bar app for uploading files and screenshots to a self-hosted WordPress site. The media URL lands on your clipboard.
apps.longDescription: Drag files or screenshots onto the WordUp menu bar icon to upload them to your own WordPress site's media library, and the URL is copied to your clipboard. It signs in with WordPress Application Passwords, stores the token locally, and keeps a searchable log of API requests.
apps.requirements: macOS 15.6 or later and a self-hosted WordPress site
features: Drag and drop files onto the menu bar icon
Uploaded media URL copied to the clipboard
Signs in with WordPress Application Passwords
Searchable API request log
